Urban Concierge Brief: SF Bay Area

Wednesday Nov 4 – Friday Nov 6, 2026 · Snapshot compiled Wed Nov 4, 2026, 6:15 am PT (BayAreaDailySync)

What changed since the last brief (Tue 10:10 pm): Little. NWS issued a new Beach Hazards Statement for SF, 5 am Thu to 7 pm Sat (sneaker waves, rip currents, 12–16 ft breakers); the Coastal Flood Advisory starts this morning as planned. Forecast, Caltrans closures, BART alerts and events are unchanged; the parade is still on today 12–2 pm.

Weather and alerts

NWS (SF, forecast updated 1:21 am Wed): Wed sunny, high near 66, north wind gusts to 20 mph · Thu mostly sunny, high near 69 · Fri mostly sunny, high near 70 · lows near 53.
Source: https://forecast.weather.gov/MapClick.php?lat=37.7749&lon=-122.4194&unit=0&lg=english&FcstType=text&TextType=1

Coastal Flood Advisory (reissued 12:33 am Wed), 6 am Wed Nov 4 to 1 pm Mon Nov 9, SF County: up to 1.6 ft of flooding in low-lying shoreline areas; isolated road closures possible. SF high tides: 8:00 am Wed (+1.0 ft), 8:35 am Thu (+1.3 ft), 9:08 am Fri (+1.4 ft).
NEW: Beach Hazards Statement, 5 am Thu Nov 5 to 7 pm Sat Nov 7, SF: higher risk of sneaker waves and strong rip currents, breaking waves 12–16 ft. Stay off jetties and rocks and don't turn your back on the ocean.
Source: https://api.weather.gov/alerts/active?point=37.7749,-122.4194

  • SF, Wed Nov 4, Valkyries parade: NB Embarcadero/EB King (3rd & King to Broadway), Market (Drumm–Steuart), Steuart and Spear closed 12:01 am–4 pm; SB Embarcadero, WB King, Washington, Mission–Bryant (Main to Embarcadero), Brannan, Townsend and Second (Brannan–King) 8 am–4 pm. https://www.sfmta.com/travel-updates/valkyries-wnba-championship-parade-wednesday-november-4-2026
  • SR-1 Tom Lantos (Devil's Slide) Tunnels: both directions closed Thu Nov 5, 8 pm – Fri 4 am (annual drill); detour Sharp Park Rd, Skyline, I-280, SR-92. https://dot.ca.gov/caltrans-near-me/district-4/d4-news/2026-11-03-tom-lantos-tunnel
  • UPDATED: I-80 Vallejo: Tue night cancelled for weather; single lane east of Georgia St and EB on-ramp at Magazine St closed Wed Nov 4 and Thu Nov 5, 8 pm–5 am. Detour Laurel, Stefan, Miller Ave on-ramp. https://dot.ca.gov/caltrans-near-me/district-4/d4-news/2026-11-03-i80-vallejo-lane-and-ramp-closures
  • SR-4 Brentwood: full closures both directions, nightly 7 pm–5 am through Thu Nov 5, Balfour Rd to Byron Hwy. https://dot.ca.gov/caltrans-near-me/district-4/d4-news/2026-11-02-sr4-overnight-full-closures
  • Mill Valley: NB US-101 to NB SR-1 connector ramp closes when high tides flood it; lower Manzanita Park and Ride stays closed. https://dot.ca.gov/caltrans-near-me/district-4/d4-news/2026-11-03-us101-sr1-connector
  • Antioch Bridge (SR-160): one-way traffic control with pilot car Fri Nov 6, 10 pm – Sat 6 am, 25 mph. https://dot.ca.gov/caltrans-near-me/district-4/d4-news/2026-11-02-sr116-antioch-bridge
  • SR-82 (El Camino Real), Burlingame: NB lanes closed Rosedale–Carmelita through Fri Nov 6, 9 am–6 pm; detour via California Dr. https://dot.ca.gov/caltrans-near-me/district-4/d4-news/2026-11-01-sr82-short-term-closure-ecr-tree-work
  • Carried from earlier briefs (not re-read this run): US-101 Marin nightly lane/ramp closures through Sat Nov 7 · SR-12 Denverton Bridge one-way control nightly through Fri · San Mateo EB SR-92 and SB US-101 lane closures Thu night · US-101 San Mateo County weeknight closures through late Nov · SR-37 Petaluma River Bridge one lane each way nightly through Nov 7 · SB US-101 Hospital Curve closed Fri Nov 6, 11 pm – Mon 6 am.
  • Looking ahead: SR-12 at Boas Dr, Santa Rosa, nightly lane closures from Mon Nov 9, 6 pm–6 am. https://dot.ca.gov/caltrans-near-me/district-4/d4-news/2026-11-02-sr12-nghtly-lane-closure
  • Live conditions: https://quickmap.dot.ca.gov and 511.org.

What's on (each confirmed on an official page)

1) Golden State Valkyries Championship Parade: Wed Nov 4, 12–2 pm. Ferry Building (near Mission St) along the bay side of The Embarcadero to King and 2nd. Free; fans can line up from 9 am. Sunny, around 66.
https://www.valkyries.com/parade · https://www.sfmta.com/travel-updates/valkyries-wnba-championship-parade-wednesday-november-4-2026

2) Ferry Plaza Farmers Market (Thursday edition): Thu Nov 5, 10 am–2 pm. Outside the Ferry Building; 10 to 15 vendors with street-food lunch and fresh produce. Free entry.
https://www.foodwise.org/farmers-markets/ferry-plaza-farmers-market/

3) Exploratorium After Dark – Digest This: Thu Nov 5, 6–10 pm. Pier 15. Adults only (18+); the night traces the history and science of how we eat, "from the first taste to the final flush." Tickets online; free for members.
https://www.exploratorium.edu/visit/calendar/after-dark-digest-this

4) Warriors vs. Miami Heat: Thu Nov 5, 7 pm. Chase Center. Klay Thompson and Andrew Wiggins return to Chase Center with Miami. TV: NBCSBA, NBA TV. Your Chase Center event ticket doubles as a Muni fare that day (not cable cars).
https://www.nba.com/warriors/home · https://www.nba.com/heat/game/0022600188-heat-vs-warriors-san-francisco-ca-11-05-2026

5) Every Saturday Night (A.C.T. / SFBATCO): closing week, through Sat Nov 7. Strand Theater, 1127 Market St. A new musical moving between today's Fillmore and the 1950s "Harlem of the West." Ages 13+. Showtimes are on the ticket page.
https://www.act-sf.org/whats-on/activate/every-saturday-night

6) SF Symphony: Isabel Leonard Sings Ravel: Fri Nov 6, 7:30 pm. Davies Symphony Hall, 201 Van Ness Ave. Fabien Gabel conducts Ravel's Shéhérazade, d'Indy and Strauss. Free pre-concert talk one hour before; Día de los Muertos altars in the lobby through Nov 11.
https://www.sfsymphony.org/Buy-Tickets/2026-27/Isabel-Leonard-Sings-Ravel

Coming up per SFMTA: Hayes Valley Farmers Market and Shared Spaces closures Fridays 4–10 pm; Veterans Day Parade and Head West Marketplace Sun Nov 8. https://www.sfmta.com/travel-updates

Where to eat

No Yelp ratings (Yelp blocks automated loads). New picks this run, each from its Michelin page opened today.

The Progress, Fillmore, SF (1525 Fillmore St) · Californian · Michelin One Star. Around the corner from the Fillmore; Michelin calls it a "sunny NorCal-meets-Nordic destination," two stories of wood, stone and tile. +1 415-673-1294. https://guide.michelin.com/us/en/california/san-francisco/restaurant/the-progress

San Ho Won, Mission, SF (2170 Bryant St) · Korean · Michelin One Star. From chefs Corey Lee and Jeong-In Hwang; Michelin notes reservations are "difficult to come by." +1 415-868-4479. https://guide.michelin.com/us/en/california/san-francisco/restaurant/san-ho-won

Commis, Oakland (3859 Piedmont Ave) · Contemporary · Michelin Two Stars. Chef/owner James Syhabout's "serene" Piedmont Avenue dining room, "packed every night." +1 510-653-3902. https://guide.michelin.com/us/en/california/oakland/restaurant/commis

Chez Panisse, Berkeley (1517 Shattuck Ave) · Californian · in the Michelin Guide. Alice Waters' "high temple to locavorism," with an open kitchen. +1 510-548-5525. https://guide.michelin.com/us/en/california/berkeley/restaurant/chez-panisse

Getting around

Muni and cable cars (re-checked): $2.85 single ride with Clipper or tap-to-pay ($3.00 cash), good 120 min; MuniMobile no longer sells single rides (since Sep 1). Day pass $5.70. Cable car $9.00. Visitor Passports $15 / $35 / $47 (1/3/7-day). Youth 18 and under ride free (not cable cars). https://www.sfmta.com/getting-around/muni/fares
Muni reroutes Wed 5 am–3 pm (parade): F, N, 2, 9, 9R, 12, 14, 14R, 15; buses run F line service all day.

  • Live feed (6:12 am Wed): only the planned 30-min delays Millbrae–SFO–Daly City from 9 pm Sun–Thu. All elevators in service.
  • Yellow Line late-night single tracking in Contra Costa through Nov 6.
  • Reduced BART-to-OAK service Wed night Nov 4 (about 9-min average waits).
  • Powell St. entrance at 4th and Market closed through Nov 10.
  • Coming up: Yellow Line single tracking Nov 12–13 · 24th St–Daly City bus bridge, no Green Line, Nov 14–15 · Transbay Tube single tracking Nov 21.
    https://www.bart.gov/schedules/advisories

Union Square has most major hotels and the best transit links (Powell BART's 4th & Market entrance is closed through Nov 10).
